name: directional-drawer
blurb: Slide-out drawer from any direction with responsive mobile/desktop behavior.
description: A DirectionalDrawer using vaul library with configurable direction (left/right/top/bottom); responsive 450px desktop or 90% mobile; dismissible on mobile with backdrop overlay.
use_when: Creating navigation sidebars or slide-out panels that adapt to desktop and mobile screens.
avoid_when: When you need the drawer to always fill the viewport — consider a full-height drawer instead.
a11y: Dismissible on mobile; close button/handle visible; backdrop click closes drawer; Escape key supported via vaul.
